name: Aogumo
source:
A military officer in charge of managing executions.
[spoiler]For this reason, he harbors a strong hatred toward [url=/c74513]Akaza[/url], [url=/c74515]Rikuu[/url] and others, who advocate for the abolition of executions, and plots various schemes to bring about their downfall.[/spoiler]
